stem.en: Meera's ₹2,000 Diwali gift is gone after three weeks, and nothing she bought cost more than ₹250. Which explanation fits what happened?

text.en: One purchase took most of the money, and a few small payments used up the rest.
Many small payments added up to the whole gift, and none of them felt big.
Small payments cannot use up ₹2,000, so the money must still be in the house.
She spent only on wants, and a want always costs more than a need.

explanation.en: Twelve payments between ₹60 and ₹250 add up to ₹2,000. Each one was small, so none of them felt like spending much. A plan made before the money is spent shows where it will go.

hints.en: Add up what she spent in one week, then think about three weeks.
